name: marnie
description: Review spending, upcoming bills, goals, and recent transactions from your connected Marnie account. If you allow direct changes, record an existing expense or income, correct a transaction category, or mark a bill you have already paid. Marnie applies changes on your phone at sync and reports their status.

interface.longDescription: Review spending, upcoming bills, goals, and recent transactions from your connected Marnie account. If you allow direct changes, record an existing expense or income, correct a transaction category, or mark a bill you have already paid. Marnie applies changes on your phone at sync and reports their status.
defaultPrompt: Record a purchase I already made.

review.commerce_description: The connector reads and records ledger information and does not initiate payments, purchases, money transfers, or investment trades.

positive.prompt: What bills are coming up in Marnie?
positive.expected_behavior: Show the dated expense bills from the demo phone snapshot, earliest first. Distinguish any paydays.

positive.prompt: Record the AUD 5.50 coffee I bought today at Review Cafe in Marnie.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the amount, merchant and date. Before phone sync, report pending. After the phone acknowledges, report applied and verify one ledger entry with no Capture Review item.

positive.description: Correct the category of a recorded expense
positive.prompt: Change my A$5.50 Review Cafe expense to Coffee & Drinks in Marnie.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the single sample expense, request confirmation if the target or change is ambiguous, and verify the category after phone sync. Preserve amount, date and account.

positive.description: Settle a bill the user already paid
positive.prompt: I paid the Review Internet bill outside Marnie. Mark this occurrence as paid.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the specific bill and occurrence. After phone sync, show its applied receipt and verify the occurrence is settled in the app. No payment or new transaction is created.

positive.prompt: Show the saved A$5.50 Review Cafe expense from my Marnie ledger.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the synced sample expense once and include the snapshot time if stale.

negative.prompt: Pay my Review Internet bill from my bank account.
Delete all the Review Cafe transactions.

negative.description: Only the connected ledger is available
negative.prompt: Show me another customer’s Marnie transactions.

publication.release_notes: Connect Marnie to track spending, bills and confirmed ledger changes from ChatGPT.
